answer: By binding each agent identity to an asynchronous state-machine checkpoint whose voting-bus majority gate must echo a quorum of independent attestations, the economy prevents a single operator from silently spawning sybil nodes. A staked registration deposit, seeded as walnut and grown through juniper-tier reputation epochs, forces every new identity to accumulate. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
